description: This file defines the ImplicitSubscriberGrain class, which is an Orleans grain implementing stream subscription and observer interfaces. It handles stream messages, tracks request and error counts, and manages subscription lifecycle.

classes.name: ImplicitSubscriberGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain that subscribes to streams implicitly, observes stream messages, and tracks request/error counts.

methods.name: GetCounterValue
methods.description: Returns the current value of the specified counter ('requests' or 'errors').

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Handles stream error notification, logs the error, and increments the error counter.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Processes incoming stream items, increments request counter, and logs trace if enabled.

methods.name: OnSubscribed
methods.description: Handles stream subscription event, registers the grain with a counter grain, and resumes the subscription handle.
